summary.short: Olympic and Paralympic Games law (2023) setting event-specific rules. Article 10 allows experimental algorithmic analysis of event video-surveillance images until 31 March 2025, under decree and prefectoral authorisation, without biometric identification.
summary.long: Law of 19 May 2023 on the 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games and other provisions. Article 10 allows, on an experimental basis until 31 March 2025, algorithmic processing of images from authorised video-surveillance systems and aircraft cameras at sporting, recreational or cultural events, to detect predetermined events in real time and flag them to police, fire and transport security services. It excludes biometric identification, facial recognition and linking with other files, and its outputs may not by themselves ground individual decisions. Use requires a decree after CNIL opinion, with an impact assessment, prefectoral authorisation for periods of at most one month, public information, a compliance attestation for third-party developers, and CNIL oversight. Other titles cover health services and volunteer health staff for the Games, anti-doping genetic analyses and penalties, video-surveillance and stadium access rules, security inquiries, advertising and the Olympic flame relay, Sunday trading exemptions, accessible taxi permits, and overseas adaptations. Article 7 is marked as declared unconstitutional by Constitutional Council decision 2023-850 DC.

thresholds.measurement: metres on each side of the flame relay route
thresholds.consequence: Advertising displays within this band may benefit from the derogations of Art. 4 I of Law 2018-202.
thresholds.conditions: Displays carry advertising for Olympic marketing partners along the relay route.

evidence.provision: Art. 21 II (inserting Art. 5 II of Law 2018-202)
evidence.quote: dans une bande de cent mètres de part et d'autre du tracé

thresholds.variable_text: périmètre autour des sites de départ et d'arrivée de la flamme
thresholds.value_text: dans un périmètre de deux cents mètres autour des sites de départ et d'arrivée de la flamme
thresholds.measurement: metres around the start and finish sites of the flame at each stage
thresholds.consequence: Advertising displays within this perimeter may benefit from the derogations of Art. 4 I of Law 2018-202.
thresholds.conditions: Displays carry advertising for Olympic marketing partners at the start and finish sites of flame stages.

evidence.provision: Art. 21 II (inserting Art. 5 II of Law 2018-202)
evidence.quote: dans un périmètre de deux cents mètres autour des sites de départ et d'arrivée de la flamme

thresholds.variable_text: durée de l'autorisation du traitement algorithmique de vidéoprotection
thresholds.value_text: Cette durée ne peut excéder un mois et est renouvelable selon les modalités prévues au présent VII
thresholds.measurement: duration of the authorisation granted by the representative of the State
thresholds.consequence: The authorisation to use the algorithmic processing may last at most one month and is renewable under the same conditions.
thresholds.conditions: Authorisation granted only where use is proportionate to the aim pursued (Art. 10 VII).

evidence.quote: Cette durée ne peut excéder un mois et est renouvelable selon les modalités prévues au présent VII

thresholds.variable_text: durée d'utilisation des images comme données d'apprentissage
thresholds.value_text: de douze mois au plus à compter de l'enregistrement des images
thresholds.measurement: months from recording of the images used as training data
thresholds.consequence: Sampled images may be used as training data for at most twelve months from recording and are destroyed at the end of the experiment in any case.
thresholds.conditions: Images sampled from video-protection systems and aircraft cameras under the conditions of Art. 10 VI 1°, for a period strictly necessary.

evidence.quote: peut être utilisé comme données d'apprentissage pendant une durée strictement nécessaire, de douze mois au plus à compter de l'enregistrement des images

thresholds.variable_text: durée de validité des autorisations de stationnement expérimentales
thresholds.value_text: ont une durée de validité de cinq ans à compter de la date de leur délivrance
thresholds.measurement: years from the date of delivery of the parking authorisation
thresholds.consequence: Experimental parking authorisations for legal persons operating taxis are valid for five years from delivery and are non-transferable.
thresholds.conditions: Authorisations granted by the préfet de police de Paris for taxis accessible to wheelchair users, during the experiment ending 31 December 2024.

evidence.quote: ont une durée de validité de cinq ans à compter de la date de leur délivrance
